policy.basis: Official baseline archives plus five percent byte headroom for npm. Python permits a bounded generated public-type delta: 347 unified output models at up to 1,024 unpacked bytes each; Memory also permits 126 direct/convenience output models at up to 2,048 unpacked bytes each. Compressed Python deltas permit up to 128 bytes per declared output model. Public file counts remain unchanged; no source maps or bundled dependency trees.
policy.source: Official npm and PyPI registry archives downloaded and integrity-verified on 2026-10-17 UTC
